title: Count Number Of Texts
description:
A string of key presses uses only digits `2` through `9`. On digits `2` through `6` and `8`, one to three consecutive presses select one of three letters. Digits `7` and `9` each map one to four consecutive presses to one of four letters. Return the number of possible letter strings represented by `pressedKeys`, modulo `10^9 + 7`.

## Examples

```text
Input: pressedKeys = "22233"
Output: 8
```

```text
Input: pressedKeys = "222222222222222222222222222222222222"
Output: 82876089
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= pressedKeys.length <= 10^5`
- `pressedKeys` contains only digits `2` through `9`.
